name: trellis
description: Keep the guidance agents need close to the work they do.

interface.shortDescription: Give agents clear standards for doing and reviewing work.
interface.longDescription: Trellis preserves working methods in handbooks beside the work. Shape Handbook clarifies consequential owner decisions, creates or improves the requested guidance, and reviews its coherence and usability. Handbook READMEs explain use without Trellis installed. Learn From Work asks about missing context when it would change a lesson, then proposes improvements from selected experience. Review-only Shaping and Learning write nothing; Shaping writes only inside selected handbooks. People and agents carry out the work under their task permissions.
defaultPrompt: Shape a handbook for this area.
Review this handbook for coherence and useful working guidance.
Learn from this work and recommend useful handbook improvements.
